worldcombat.skill.scald.summary: Boils a kettle of water in its palm and hurls it: the scalding water arcs onto the target, dealing special damage and possibly burning, and thaws frozen on the target and the user. A target standing in water or rain is scalded harder. It can also be thrown deliberately at a frozen ally to thaw it without hurting it.
worldcombat.skill.scald.use.0: Burn a target from range with a thrown kettle of boiling water
worldcombat.skill.scald.use.1: Thaw frozen on the target and on yourself (or throw at a frozen ally to thaw it)
worldcombat.skill.scald.use.2: Scald an already-wet target for extra damage
worldcombat.skill.scald.description.0: A hit deals about %1$s special damage; the target's special defence, type matchup and criticals are settled on impact.
worldcombat.skill.scald.description.1: The glob arcs out to a range of %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick.
worldcombat.skill.scald.description.2: On a hit there is a %1$s chance to leave the target burned: while burning its physical damage is halved and it loses about 6.25%% of its maximum health every 5 seconds (at least 1), lasting about 40 seconds, with Fire types immune.
worldcombat.skill.scald.rule.thaw: A hit thaws the target's frozen; the move can also be used while frozen, clearing the user's own frozen as it winds up.
worldcombat.skill.scald.rule.wet: A target that is in water or rain is scalded worse: hit damage x1.18.
worldcombat.skill.scald.rule.ally: Thrown deliberately at a frozen ally, it only thaws that ally and raises a splash on real contact, never dealing damage; both ally and enemy hits land only on real contact.
worldcombat.skill.scald.rule.wall: Striking a block only trickles a drop and steam at the contact point; it leaves no lasting puddle on the ground and creates no puddle at range.
worldcombat.skill.scald.simmer.on: Long-boil: +0.10 direct burn chance (still capped at 50%), a 3 tick longer wind-up and +10 cooldown, at the cost of x0.9 direct power.
worldcombat.skill.scald.simmer.off: Flash-boil: x1.06 direct power and -2 cooldown, with the burn chance at its base value.
worldcombat.skill.scald.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.scald.growth.0: From level %1$s the boil rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.scald.growth.1: From level %1$s the boil rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.scald.preference.simme: On: +0.10 direct burn chance (still capped at 50%), a 3 tick longer wind-up and +10 cooldown, at the cost of x0.9 direct power, for setting a target alight. Off (flash-boil): x1.06 direct power and -2 cooldown, with the burn chance at its base value, for picking a target off.
worldcombat.skill.scald.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
worldcombat.skill.scald.preference.ai.so: On: targets standing in water or rain rank first for the extra 18% scald damage; off: order by ordinary ranged attack only.
